name: Full Smile
verdict: Full Smile delivered 130 leads at a $11.02 CPL over the last 28 days, driven entirely by Meta (top campaign: "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" at $895.86 spend). The biggest movement is a 36.59% drop in GBP activity week-over-week, likely reflecting reduced organic search visibility or engagement on the Google Business Profile rather than a paid issue, as Meta spend only nudged up 6.59%.

performance.verdict: Meta leads holding but GBP collapse and zero GHL appointments expose a post-click conversion black hole.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones past due (LSA over-counting, phone-match attribution, caption guide, credentials rotation, OD patient groups) — delivery risk in prove-it month.
4 upcoming SOW milestones due Aug 14–31 (doctor hours, OD merge, dashboard, stay/walk decision) — no confirmed completion; August scoreboard integrity at risk.
CPL rose 6.59% this week to ~$11.02 while lead volume held flat at 0% change — spend efficiency eroding with no volume gain; last 3 days (Aug 5–7) average 4 leads/day vs 4.7 prior 3 days (Aug 2–4).
GBP actions collapsed -36.59% week-over-week; last 2 days show 0 GBP actions each — organic local visibility is losing ground exactly when August scoreboard demands attribution.
130 leads generated but GHL shows 0 appointments and 0 won opportunities over 28 days — 102 opps created with $0 value means leads are entering but not scheduling; intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake pipeline: 102 opps created, 0 appointments booked — trace where leads stall within 3 business days.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 102 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked over the last 28 days despite 130 leads delivered at $11.02 CPL — leads are arriving but not converting to scheduled visits. Map each stage where opps are stalling (new lead → contacted → booked) and identify whether the block is response time, missing automation, or Lily/new intake hire workflow. Success is confirmed when at least 10% of new leads (roughly 13 of the next 130) result in a booked appointment visible in GHL. Resolve and report by 2026-08-14 to align with the Lily sit-down milestone.

suggestions.text: Restore GBP posting cadence immediately; 2 consecutive zero-action days risk Aug scoreboard organic attribution.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped -36.59% week-over-week, with 0 actions recorded on both Aug 6 and Aug 7 — a dangerous signal in a prove-it month where organic visibility feeds the lead-to-patient scoreboard. Publish at minimum 2 GBP posts and verify the profile has no suppressed Q&A or unclaimed photos this week. Success check: GBP weekly actions return above the prior 7-day baseline (last measured at the pre-drop level) by 2026-08-14.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL: if 3-day average CPL exceeds $13 (vs current $11.02 baseline), trigger creative refresh on BWS campaign.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL rose 6.59% this week to $11.02 with lead volume flat — the 3-day signal (Aug 5–7: 4 leads/day avg vs 4.7 prior 3 days) is a soft downward drift, not yet a confirmed break. No budget move is warranted yet. Re-check on 2026-08-11: if CPL has crossed $13 or daily leads drop below 3 for 3 consecutive days, escalate to a creative refresh on the BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign ($895.86 spend, top campaign).
